findings.original_issue: Global menu legality alone excluded arbitrary requests in physically unreachable histories.
findings.resolution: SupportedPolicy adds a raw real randomized comparison class and supported-local admissibility, proving the same original solve output dominates it.

findings.result: No reviewed selector or memory update receives the true hidden parameter, protected resident program, true parent, or full Store; these occur only on the world side of source/equality proofs.

Finite protocol time, per-request native physical updates and Store clocks remain distinct. Stop is remaining root-idle, and undispatched residents are not subjected to a newly invented global fault tick.

The actual tape, original record payoff, exact prefix native fees, supported real randomized optimality and original founder instantiation are explicitly composed in NativeConsumer; no final physical witness remains assumed.

validation_limits: This report records source semantic review; the reviewer did not independently rerun Lean for these non-author modules. Root performs and records actual compilation separately.

The reviewer authored FiniteJointDecisionSolver, its Execution helper, FilteredModel, RegisterJointDecisionOptimality, FiniteJointDecisionFastSolver, and the minimal posterior normalization-cache patch. This report does not claim independent review of those author changes.

Conditional Bayes optimality is restricted to the registered source, permitted information, finite protocol horizon, prepayment rule and objective. It is not a minimax, oracle, universal empirical, or all-population-scheduling claim.
